pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with highly irregular, serrated edges exhibiting sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area is larger on the mid-flank and significantly smaller and more fragmented on the shoulder and upper forelimb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform but narrower than the adjacent dark patches, maintaining high continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a consistent, high-frequency serration along the dorsal neck line, appearing as a dark brown jagged silhouette against the background vegetation.
